instructions:
You advise an operational agent that must answer the principal's need with live data. Propose
(1) public data APIs that need no key and return JSON relevant to the questions -- give exact GET URLs with every
parameter filled in from the resolved subjects (coordinates, time zone, identifiers), and the JSON paths you expect
in the answer; and (2) pages of existing services people already use that answer the question directly (give the
exact page URL for this subject, plus the link texts a person would click from the site's home page to reach it,
in case the URL has moved). Each proposal is fetched and checked; propose only what you are confident exists.
Prefer few, reliable sources. If nothing beyond what was already observed is relevant, return empty lists.

need.sentence: Every morning, tell me whether it's a good day to dry laundry outside in Osaka.

questions.quantity: Overall verdict for today's daytime drying period (roughly 08:00-18:00 local), derived from the conditions below: no rain during the drying period and conditions that dry clothes reasonably (not too humid, some wind or sun).
questions.question: Is today a good day to dry laundry outside in Osaka?
questions.population: Osaka city, today, daytime hours when laundry would be hanging out

questions.quantity: Maximum hourly probability of precipitation, and expected precipitation amount, between 08:00 and 18:00 local today
questions.question: What is the chance of rain in Osaka during today's daytime drying period?

questions.quantity: Daytime average relative humidity, wind speed, temperature and cloud cover/sunshine
questions.question: How favourable are the drying conditions today (humidity, wind, temperature, sunshine)?

questions.quantity: Presence of pollen, PM2.5/yellow-sand or strong wind or typhoon warnings affecting Osaka today
questions.question: Are there outdoor factors that make drying outside undesirable (heavy pollen, PM2.5/yellow sand, strong wind, typhoon)?

deliverable.why: 'Every morning, tell me' means a short daily proactive message with a clear verdict and a one-line reason, readable in seconds. The time is not stated, so 07:00 is an assumed default, before laundry is typically hung out.

payload.instruction: Every source above was rejected for the stated reason (robots.txt disallow is final: do not propose that host again). Propose different sources.

url.description: full GET URL, parameters filled in

expected_fields.description: dotted JSON paths, list indexes as numbers

link_texts.description: visible link texts a person would click, from the site's home page to this page, in the site's language
